about: Draft per-state NEC adoption rows (spec-v1968). Each row's citation is the source of truth; the NFPA column is a cross-check only. A row ships to data/legal/code-adoption.json only after a maintainer reads its citation and sets verified_by and verified_on.

AL.scope: State buildings, schools, hotels and motels, and motion picture theaters; cities and counties adopt their own code elsewhere.

AL.draft_note: Rule section adopting NFPA 70 not located; Mike Holt lists effective 2023-07-01, IAEI and NFPA list 2022-07-01. Confirm the DCM adopted-codes rule.
